sources.title: Restricted Successive Minima
sources.enterprise_use: Identifies the P025 minimum non-degenerate witness radius as a special case of a restricted first successive minimum: use the cube [-1,1]^S, additive witness lattice T, and forbidden degeneracy sublattice T^circ. Provides the prior-art neighborhood for bounds on shortest lattice points avoiding sublattices.
sources.not_claimed: Restricted successive minima, shortest lattice points outside forbidden sublattices, Siegel-lemma avoidance bounds, and their Geometry-of-Numbers theory are established prior mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
